svg.title: KV bytes per position and valid versus reserved payload
svg.desc: Thirty two layers eight KV heads width one hundred twenty eight and two bytes per element produce one hundred twenty eight KiB per position. Four thousand ninety six positions take five hundred twelve MiB. Three unequal valid lengths total eight hundred ninety six MiB versus fifteen hundred thirty six MiB reserved.
svg.text: From one retained position to request payload
Uniform full attention: L = 32, Hkv = 8, d = 128, w = 2 bytes
K and V: 2 × 32 × 8 × 128 × 2 = 131,072 bytes per position
131,072 bytes = 128 KiB per request, across all layers
4 such requests → 2 GiB of valid KV payload
Counts stored KV heads, not query heads.
4096 reserved slots for each request → 1536 MiB
640 MiB is reserved beyond valid rows; do not add validity again.
Payload excludes weights, workspace, metadata and allocator overhead.
Hypothetical configuration; no device allocation or bandwidth was measured.
